Overview

Budva is a city in Budva with a population of 19,000. Montenegro’s most famous coastal resort town, known for its medieval Old Town, vibrant nightlife, and the beautiful beaches of the Budva Riviera. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
